initialExam.title: SSC Head Constable (Delhi Police) 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment of Head Constable (Ministerial) in Delhi Police for clerical and office management duties at police stations and offices. A popular recruitment for 12th pass candidates seeking a career in Delhi Police.
initialExam.qualifications: 12th Standard (Higher Secondary) pass from a recognized Board
initialExam.syllabus: General Awareness / GK (25Q), English Language (25Q), Quantitative Aptitude (25Q), Computer Fundamentals (25Q). Topics: History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Current Affairs, Comprehension, Error Spotting, Vocabulary, Number System, Percentage, Ratio, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Data Interpretation, MS Office, Internet, Networking Basics.
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 100 questions, 200 marks, 90 minutes. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer. Physical Endurance & Measurement Test. Typing/Computer Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Computer Based Test (CBT) → Physical Endurance & Measurement Test (PE&MT) → Typing / Computer Test → Document Verification → Medical Examination

salaryRange.description: Pay Level 3 (7th CPC) with Delhi Police allowances

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years, Ex-Servicemen: as per rules

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, Medical, Pension (NPS), Uniform Allowance, Risk Allowance
initialExam.careerGrowth: Head Constable → ASI → Sub-Inspector → Inspector through departmental exams and promotions.
initialExam.jobRole: Clerical and administrative duties at police stations and district offices of Delhi Police including record maintenance, typing, and correspondence.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register/Login on SSC portal 3. Fill application form 4. Upload photo & signature 5. Pay fee online 6. Print confirmation

previousYearPapers.topics: History, Geography, Polity, Economics, Science, Current Affairs, Delhi Police related GK, Sports, Awards
